purpose: Map the Kingdom Atlas relationship families onto useful D1-D11 analytical roles without assigning any family a permanent spiritual rank.
master_rule: Every empirically grounded relationship begins with its observable/material record at D4 when such a record exists. Other dimensions are projections of history, state, threshold, recurrence, generativity, composition, transmission, integration or project-symbolic interpretation. A family can occupy several dimensions at once.

genealogical.reading: D3 preserves ancestry/provenance; D4 records documented family/succession relations; D6 tracks generational change; D7 represents descendants and generated lineages; D8/D10 apply only where kinship composes durable institutions or ownership/control systems.
genealogical.risk: ancestral guilt or inferring biological relation from symbolic lineage

institutional.reading: D4 records jurisdiction/membership; D5 records admission, authorization, delegation or exit; D8 models differentiated institutions composing a larger order; D10 shows system governance; D2 only when capture/blocked exit is evidenced; D11 only for explicit constitutional/objective criteria.
institutional.risk: equating institutional height with moral legitimacy

financial.reading: D4 holds instruments, balances and transfers; D3 provenance/creditor history; D5 maturity, covenant, default, restructuring or settlement; D6 rollover and changing exposure; D10 aggregate balance-sheet/network burden; D2 only for evidenced capture or exit friction.
financial.risk: confusing debt with guilt, power or project-symbolic karmic debt

political.reading: D4 records treaties, votes and diplomacy; D5 accession/activation/withdrawal; D8 durable alliance and institutional composition; D9 diplomatic relay; D10 coalition/alliance system effects; D11 only where shared constitutional or strategic criteria are explicit.
political.risk: treating alliances as automatically virtuous because they are highly integrated

religious.reading: D4 records people/institutions/practices where measurable; D3 history/textual provenance; D6 change; D8 communities/institutions; D9 teaching and transmission. D5/D7/D10/D11 may describe thresholds, generativity or project-comparative interpretation but must not turn theology into empirical proof.
religious.risk: inferring individual belief, politics or moral rank from affiliation

intellectual.reading: D3 source genealogy; D4 documented authorship/citation; D6 evolution of ideas; D7 downstream work/capability; D9 knowledge relay; D10 schools/research systems; D11 explicit evaluation criteria or invariants.
intellectual.risk: treating conceptual similarity as historical influence without evidence

geographic.reading: D4 is the principal plane for actual geography; D3 historical boundaries/routes; D5 crossings/access rules; D10 system geography such as corridors and chokepoints; D8 only where geography supports a composed regional system.
geographic.risk: turning symbolic dimensions into literal underground/upper geography

cultural.reading: D4 observable cultural indicators/institutions; D3 inherited memory; D6 cultural change; D7 creative generativity; D8 cultures as differentiated Rooms; D9 transmission/exchange; D10 system-wide cultural integration only with declared methodology.
cultural.risk: reducing cultures to one rank or treating affinity as proof of political alliance

technological.reading: D4 assets/dependencies; D3 ownership/version provenance; D5 access/licensing thresholds; D6 upgrades/change; D8 interoperable systems; D9 standards/technology transfer; D10 integrated technical capability; D2 lock-in only when evidenced.
technological.risk: calling ordinary technical dependency capture without measuring alternatives/exit costs

information.reading: D4 documented information flow; D3 archive/provenance; D6 changing narratives/versions; D9 source-mediator-recipient transmission; D10 information-system integration; D2 recursion/capture only when persistent loops are evidenced; D5 access/classification gates.
information.risk: treating repetition as corroboration or inferred hidden communication as fact

social.reading: D4 observed social relations; D3 shared history; D6 sustained/changeable reciprocity; D7 generative friendship/care and autonomous capacity; D8 durable community/institutional composition; D2 only for evidenced capture/blocked exit.
social.risk: inferring friendship, hostility or hidden coordination from proximity or co-membership

symbolic.reading: Symbolic relations are non-empirical context unless independently evidenced. D3 traces provenance, D6 motif transformation, D7-D11 support project-symbolic generativity/composition/transmission/integration/meta-orientation. D4 is used only for the real artifact/text/event that carries the symbol.
symbolic.risk: analogy becoming proof or symbolic adjacency becoming a hidden empirical relation

functional.reading: D4 records actual inputs/outputs/services; D5 operational thresholds; D6 changing performance; D7 generated capacity; D8 modular system composition; D9 relay; D10 integrated function and bottlenecks; D2 only for measured lock-in/failure loops.
functional.risk: using function as a moral ranking rather than a measurable system role

mythological.reading: This family is internal to Potatoverse/project canon. It can use the full symbolic Axis, but D4 is reserved for real-world attestations, texts, artworks, dates, platforms or places connected to the mythological record—not supernatural proof.
mythological.risk: project canon overwriting empirical evidence or political/legal authority

ui_implication: A future relationship inspector should show family + D4 facts first, then a compact Axis strip highlighting only the dimensions justified for that particular edge. Selecting a dimension changes the question asked of the same edge; it does not create a duplicate relationship.
